title: Tailwind CSS
description: Learn utility-first CSS with Tailwind CSS framework.

data.text: **Tailwind CSS** is a utility-first CSS framework. Instead of writing custom CSS, you apply pre-existing utility classes directly in your JSX.

data.title: Install Tailwind
data.code:
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p

data.title: Customization
data.text: Customize Tailwind by editing `tailwind.config.js` to add your brand colors, fonts, and spacing.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Utility-first approach - no custom CSS needed
Dark mode support with dark: prefix
data.takeaway: Tailwind CSS speeds up development with utility classes.
